source.quote_free_summary: Each Registry Event must offer at least two skill-level Jack and Jill contests and have at least 150 competitor entries (80 entries and 100 attendees in a Growth Region); falling short is a probation matter, results are still posted and points awarded.

requirement: Record the event-level contest and entry minimums separately from the finals minimum; they are Registry Event status conditions, not conditions on running a contest.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI.
interpretation_notes: 1.2.6.b: below the minimum, results are posted and Registry Points awarded but the event goes on probation for a year; 1.2.6.c: a shortfall during the probation year loses Registry Event status. So this does not stop contests from running. A WSDC event profile does not exist in DanceFlow.
